issue_request: FHIR-19422 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R5 asking that the SpecimenDefinition container.type value set stop reflecting the old LOINC cholesterol example and instead use SNOMED CT concepts descended from 706041008, with corrected title, name, definition, and logical definition.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-19422-tagged source commit was found. Commit 0fe60a4236d65f04316982ed97e7c352497bbc57 replaced the original LOINC cholesterol value set in source/specimendefinition with SNOMED CT concept is-a 706041008, but left generic/stale name/title/definition text. The current source also contained a source/specimen duplicate of the same canonical value set rooted at 434711009.
additional_context: Specimen and SpecimenDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.container.type binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/specimen-container-type. build.fhir.org was publishing the source/specimen copy rooted at 434711009, while the R5 publication showed the 706041008 root with stale title/definition. OO minutes from 2021-04-12 and 2021-04-29 corroborate that the value set needed the Jira-listed SNOMED CT root and was accepted in the April 2021 block vote.
reconciliation: Updated source/specimendefinition/valueset-specimen-container-type.xml and source/specimen/valueset-specimen-container-type.xml so both canonical source copies have the requested SNOMED CT name/title/description and include concept is-a 706041008.
